text:
Priya (CS): Quick flag — last night's maintenance in eu-west-1 caused delayed webhook deliveries for a subset of new onboarders. We're seeing ~12% of trials stuck in 'verifying' and a spike in retries. Need a customer status + per-tenant outreach plan ASAP. Anyone on the bridge?
Liam (Eng): On it. We rolled back the change at 02:14 UTC; backlog cleared by ~03:05 but ~120 tenants still report failed webhook callbacks. Root cause: inadvertent queue TTL change in the deploy. Patch merged and rolling to canaries now. Full RCA to follow.
Marco (AE): Can someone dump the affected list with tiers/renewal windows? I'll prioritize outreach for anything enterprise or near-renewal.
Devon (Support): Drafting templates for in-app banner + email. Short sample copy: "We're investigating delayed verifications after maintenance in eu-west-1. Your onboarding may be delayed — we're retrying and will follow up within 4 hours." Will post the drafts here in 10m.
Priya (CS): Good — include credit language options (trial/top-off). Ellen, do you want to approve compensation tiers?
Ellen (CS Manager): Propose: enterprise impacted -> 2 months credit / white-glove onboarding session; midmarket -> 1 month credit; SMB -> extended trial + 1:1 office hours. Approve?
Aisha (CS Ops): I'll start outbound to the top 30 affected accounts this morning and tag the rest for automated email. Office hours slot at 10:30 UTC.
Marco (AE): SQL to get affected tenants (run in reporting-db):
```sql
SELECT tenant_id, account_tier, renewal_date, contact_email
FROM tenants
WHERE region = 'eu-west-1'
  AND status = 'verifying'
  AND created_at >= '2026-03-20'
ORDER BY account_tier DESC, renewal_date ASC;
```
Liam (Eng): Also add last_webhook_attempt_ts and error_code to that query so CS has retry context. We'll attach logs per-tenant to the incident.
Devon (Support): Draft email subject lines: "Update: Onboarding delay for your account — we're working on it" and "Your onboarding is being retried — next steps". Short body with exact mitigations and ETA. Posting drafts in thread now.
OpsBot: Incident created INC-2026-0356 — Bridge: https://bridge.example.com/INC-2026-0356 — Pager: ops oncall paged at 02:10 UTC.
Priya (CS): Timeline we'll communicate to customers: cause (TTL change) -> rollback -> retry attempts started -> ETA for resolution: 4 hours for majority, up to 24h for edge cases. Include link to status page: https://status.redwood.example.com/incidents/INC-2026-0356.
Ellen (CS Manager): Agreed. A couple of quick asks: 1) include an explicit step for customers to contact support if they need accelerated onboarding; 2) flag any trial accounts showing high NPS risk for outreach.
Aisha (CS Ops): Doing that. I'll attach a CSV export with the first 500 impacted tenants and mark the top 30 for manual outreach. ETA: 25m.
Marco (AE): I'll queue personalized emails for the enterprise list once Aisha posts the CSV. Please add renewal_date and ARR columns.
Liam (Eng): Postmortem notes for CS: root cause = deploy changed queue TTL from 7d -> 30s for the verifications consumer; cascade: retries exhausted -> status stuck. Mitigation: TTL reverted, retries requeued, added safety check in deploy pipeline. Patch PR: https://git.internal/pr/4321.
Devon (Support): Putting together a short FAQ to include in messages (what happened, who is affected, how we're fixing it, compensation). Will post copy.
Priya (CS): Great — action items for this thread: 1) Aisha: CSV + top30 outreach (25m) 2) Devon: email + banner copy (10m) 3) Marco: personalized enterprise sends after CSV 4) Liam: attach per-tenant logs and PR link 5) Ellen: approve final compensation wording. We'll send consolidated comm by 10:00 UTC. I will update the status page and follow up with full RCA when ready. :thumbsup:
Liam (Eng): Noted, will paste the per-tenant log links to the incident after the canary finishes rolling (~15m).
Ellen (CS Manager): Thanks team. Keep the messages short and include exact ETA in each outbound copy.
Priya (CS): Thanks — ping me in thread when drafts are ready and I'll sign off before send.
